subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What pre-auth Control UI connection diagnostics may be shown and copied before the browser has an authenticated operator session?
rationale: The useful feature depends on whether handshake, device, origin, close-code, and auth failure details are safe to expose in a support-copy surface before trust is established.

options.title: Sanitized Client-Only Diagnostics
options.body: Expose client-side phase timing, retry state, close code, redacted detail codes, and copy support before auth, while leaving gateway log tails post-auth.

options.title: Authenticated Diagnostics Only
options.body: Keep pre-auth errors to current categorized guidance and expose richer logs only after operator.read is available.

options.title: Consent-Based Support Export
options.body: Design a broader export that combines redacted client diagnostics with authenticated gateway diagnostics after connection succeeds.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Client-Only Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose client-side phase timing, retry state, close code, redacted detail codes, and copy support before auth, while leaving gateway log tails post-auth.

likelyOwner.reason: The current UI architecture and app-host/gateway-store boundaries are the main implementation surface for this choice.
